  "headline": "Net revenue fell 19.4% (Rs 1.53 lakh) in the week to 17 May 2026.",
  "sentences": [
    { "text": "The net revenue declined by 19.4% (approximately Rs 1.53 lakh) in the focal period versus the prior period.", "tier_from": "answer" },
    { "text": "The primary localized driver is the West‑region Large Appliances segment, which moved down about -11.0% relative to a stable control, as shown by the difference‑in‑differences test (treated -10.96% vs control 0.0%, z=-2.7).", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "This driver passed the placebo‑timing falsification (5.79 pp vs noise std 4.0 pp) and the unaffected‑control check, reinforcing its evidential status.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "The dose‑response test for the primary driver was inconclusive, with non‑monotonic per‑period magnitudes and a negative spread, indicating uncertainty about a consistent magnitude over time.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "A secondary driver points to broader category movement in Large Appliances, with a treated decline of -11.0% versus a control increase of +4.3% (did -15.21%).", "tier_from": "drivers[1]" },
    { "text": "This secondary driver also survived placebo and control checks, but its dose‑response test was likewise inconclusive, so its causal claim remains tentative.", "tier_from": "drivers[1]" },
    { "text": "The hypothesis that the overall West‑region movement explains the drop was falsified: a falsification test showed a negligible treated change of -0.1% versus control 0.0% (z=-0.1), leading to rejection.", "tier_from": "rejected_hypotheses[0]" },
    { "text": "Decomposition attributes roughly 60% of the net‑revenue loss to volume decline, about 40% to price pressure, and a minimal mix effect.", "tier_from": "answer" },
    { "text": "Sample sizes are modest (e.g., support size 726 for the top segment) and a recent ETL order‑status mapping change has not yet been confirmed for revenue exclusion, representing a data‑quality caveat.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" }
  ]
}
